title: Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE) Trials
titleHi: खेलो इंडिया स्टेट सेंटर ऑफ एक्सीलेंस ट्रायल्स
organization: Sports Authority of India (SAI) & State Sports Departments
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: 100% free residential training, modern sports kit, nutritional diet, schooling support, and competition travel allowance.
eligibility: Open to boys and girls aged 12 to 18 who have represented their school, district, or state in athletic events (sprints, jumps, distance).
documents: Aadhaar Card or Birth Certificate (Age Proof)
District or State Level Sports Participation/Medal Certificate
Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Doctor
howToApply: Visit the official SAI or Khelo India portal to download the trial schedule. Candidates report directly to the nearest notified KISCE centre with original documents on the trial date.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Selection is strictly merit-based through physical fitness tests.

title: Army Boys Sports Company (ABSC) Induction Rally
titleHi: आर्मी बॉयज स्पोर्ट्स कंपनी (ABSC) चयन रैली
organization: Indian Army & Sports Authority of India
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free English-medium schooling up to Class 10/12, world-class wrestling mats and coaches, boarding, lodging, medical care, and pathway into the Indian Army.
eligibility: Male students between 11 and 16 years. Minimum physical standards apply. Wrestling medal holders or candidates showing natural strength and agility.
documents: Original Date of Birth Certificate from Municipal Board/Gram Panchayat
Sports Achievement Certificate (District/State level if any)
Caste and Domicile Certificate from Tehsildar
Parental Consent Affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper
howToApply: Selection rallies are held at designated Regimental Training Centres. Candidates must check the official schedule and report in the morning with sports kit.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. No fee is charged at any stage of selection.

title: SAI National Sports Talent Contest (NSTC) Scheme
titleHi: साई राष्ट्रीय खेल प्रतिभा खोज (NSTC) योजना
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Annual sports scholarship stipend, free competition archery equipment, uniform, accidental insurance, and coaching at adopted residential schools.
eligibility: Children aged 10-14 studying in rural schools. Evaluated on motor ability test: 30m sprint, vertical jump, flexibility, and archery draw tests.
documents: Birth Certificate from Registrar of Births
School Identity Card signed by Principal
Fitness Certificate from Registered Medical Practitioner
howToApply: Applications are submitted through the Headmaster or PE Teacher of the school to the regional SAI Field Office or online via SAI portal.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Open to both tribal and non-tribal rural youth.

title: SGFI Rural School Games Athletics Championship
titleHi: एसजीएफआई ग्रामीण विद्यालय एथलेटिक्स चैंपियनशिप
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: National level certificate, eligibility for national sports quota in higher education, and scouting by national federation coaches.
eligibility: Enrolled regular school students in Under-14, Under-17, and Under-19 categories qualifying through block/taluka trials.
documents: SGFI Eligibility Form signed by School Principal & District Sports Officer
Class 10 Board Certificate or Official Birth Certificate
howToApply: Contact your school Physical Education (PE) teacher. Schools register their athletes through the District Sports Office.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Only government-recognized school entries are valid.

title: Madhya Pradesh State Cricket Academy Open Talent Trials
titleHi: मध्य प्रदेश राज्य क्रिकेट अकादमी ओपन टैलेंट ट्रायल्स
organization: Department of Sports & Youth Welfare, MP Government
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free residential training academy, turf wickets, video analysis, boarding, sports gear, and participation in BCCI tournaments.
eligibility: Bonafide resident of MP or students enrolled in MP schools aged 13-18. Trials open for fast bowlers, spinners, and wicketkeeper-batsmen.
howToApply: Fill out the registration form at the District Sports Youth Welfare Office (DSYWO) or report on trial morning at the designated stadium in white cricket kit.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Wear standard cricket whites and rubber studs.

title: Haryana Rural Youth Wrestling & Dangal Encouragement Scheme
titleHi: हरियाणा ग्रामीण कुश्ती एवं दंगल प्रोत्साहन योजना
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Monthly nutritional diet allowance of Rs 3,000 - 5,000, free access to district SAI akhadas, and free wrestling mats.
eligibility: Haryana state resident wrestlers who have secured 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place in recognized district, state, or rural dangal championships.
documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
howToApply: Apply online via the Antyodaya SARAL Haryana portal or submit your file directly to the District Sports Officer (DSO).
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Scholarship directly disbursed via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).

title: Reliance Foundation Youth Sports (RFYS) Football Championship
titleHi: रिलायंस फाउंडेशन यूथ स्पोर्ट्स फुटबॉल चैंपियनशिप
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: National competitive platform, scout visibility for Indian Super League (ISL) academies, kits, balls, and trophy grant for rural schools.
eligibility: School and college student teams in Sub-Junior, Junior, and Senior categories. Both boys' and girls' school teams eligible.
documents: Consolidated Team Entry Form authorized by Principal
howToApply: The school sports coordinator or coach must register the school team on the official RFYS digital portal during the annual registration window.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Individual players cannot register alone; registration is through school teams.

title: Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) New Young Players (NYP) Grassroots Scout
titleHi: प्रो कबड्डी न्यू यंग प्लेयर्स (NYP) ग्रामीण टैलेंट स्काउट
organization: Mashal Sports & Amateur Kabaddi Federation of India (AKFI)
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Professional contract with PKL franchise teams, high-performance strength & conditioning coaching, medical coverage, and television broadcast exposure.
eligibility: Young kabaddi players aged 18-19 with proven performance in junior national kabaddi championships or state team representation.
documents: State or National Amateur Kabaddi Federation (AKFI) Certificate
Police clearance certificate for professional contract
howToApply: Participate in State Junior Championships to receive scout invitations, or attend open NYP trial camps announced on official PKL platforms.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Beware of unauthorized agents asking for money; trials are completely free.

title: Naval Tata Hockey Academy Rural Grassroots Talent Hunt
titleHi: नवल टाटा हॉकी अकादमी ग्रामीण टैलेंट हंट
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: World-class synthetic astro-turf training, Dutch coaching methodology, full academic scholarship, boarding, nutrition, and international tours.
eligibility: Boys and girls from rural and tribal belts showing exceptional speed, ball control, and hand-eye coordination in field hockey.
documents: Birth Certificate from Panchayati Raj Dept
howToApply: Report to local Grassroots Hockey Centres (GHC) across Sundargarh and Odisha during the announced annual trial dates.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Testing includes agility, speed, and hockey fundamental drills.

title: Khelo India Women's Football League & Talent Scouting
titleHi: खेलो इंडिया महिला फुटबॉल लीग एवं टैलेंट स्काउटिंग
organization: Sports Authority of India & All India Football Federation (AIFF)
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Direct entry into national junior camps, match allowances, branded playing kits, and residential academy scholarships for top performers.
eligibility: Girls aged 13-19 playing for registered rural clubs, schools, or community teams across India.
documents: AIFF CRS (Central Registration System) ID or School ID
howToApply: Participate through your district/state football association or register as a club team on the AIFF Khelo India portal.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Exclusive opportunities for young female footballers.

title: Maharashtra Krida Prabodhini Residential Sports School Trials
titleHi: महाराष्ट्र क्रीडा प्रबोधिनी निवासी क्रीडा शाळा निवड चाचणी
organization: Directorate of Sports and Youth Services, Maharashtra
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free residential school education (Class 6 to 12), specialized Kho-Kho mud and mat training, balanced athletic diet, and daily sports kit.
eligibility: Students studying in Maharashtra schools with physical fitness passing the standardized battery test (speed, stamina, vertical jump, medicine ball throw).
documents: Medical Fitness Certificate from Civil Hospital
howToApply: Application forms are available at District Sports Offices (DSO) across Maharashtra and on the official sports portal.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Physical battery test is mandatory for all applicants.

title: SAI Special Area Games (SAG) Scheme - Traditional Archery
titleHi: साई विशेष क्षेत्र खेल (SAG) योजना - पारंपरिक तीरंदाजी
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free boarding & lodging, modern recurve and compound archery gear, coaching by international archers, medical assistance, and competition exposure.
eligibility: Scouted youth from tribal, rural, and remote areas possessing natural talent in traditional archery, bow drawing, and sharp visual acuity.
documents: Scheduled Tribe (ST) or Rural Residence Certificate (if applicable)
howToApply: SAI scout teams visit remote districts and sports meets. Athletes can also appear directly at regional SAI Special Area Games centres.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Traditional bow skills are evaluated alongside modern equipment suitability.

title: BCCI District Under-19 Cricket Open Selection Camp
titleHi: बीसीसीआई जिला अंडर-19 क्रिकेट ओपन चयन शिविर
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Selection for the District Under-19 squad playing in State Inter-District tournaments; path to Cooch Behar and Vinoo Mankad trophies.
eligibility: Players born on or after the official BCCI cutoff date. Must be registered with a local club or school cricket team in the district.
documents: Digital Birth Certificate issued within 1 year of birth or hospital record
howToApply: Collect the registration form from your District Cricket Association office or groundsman. Report on match day with your cricket kit bag.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. BCCI adheres to strict TW3 bone age verification guidelines.

title: National Rural Kho-Kho Championship & Scholarship Camp
titleHi: राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण खो-खो प्रतियोगिता एवं छात्रवृत्ति शिविर
organization: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (MYAS) & State Councils
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Cash award or scholarship grant for top performing village teams, sports tracksuits, certificates, and entry into National Sports Festival.
eligibility: Kho-Kho teams representing rural Gram Panchayats and government high schools in the Junior category.
documents: Aadhaar Card of all 12 squad members
Consent letter from team coach or physical education teacher
howToApply: Submit the squad roster certified by the village panchayat secretary to the Taluka / Block Development Officer (BDO) sports coordinator.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Teams must arrive in uniform kit.

title: Sports Authority of Gujarat (SAG) District Level Sports School (DLSS)
titleHi: गुजरात खेल प्राधिकरण जिला स्तरीय खेल विद्यालय (DLSS) प्रवेश
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free residential schooling in partnered CBSE/State board schools, scientific sports nutrition, synthetic track access, and professional coaching.
eligibility: Students of Gujarat having qualifying scores in the Khel Mahakumbh or District Talent Selection Battery Test.
howToApply: Register online via the SAG DLSS admission portal or apply through the District Sports Officer during the Khel Mahakumbh festival.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Selection depends on physical battery tests and skill trials.

title: Tata Archery Academy Cadet Induction Trials
titleHi: टाटा तीरंदाजी अकादमी कैडेट प्रवेश चयन
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Elite training that has produced multiple Olympians; free equipment (Hoyt/Win&Win bows), psychological counseling, diet, schooling, and living expenses.
eligibility: Boys and girls 12 to 15 years old. Candidates undergo tests for eyesight, steady arm endurance, mental calmness, and natural posture.
documents: School Record showing current class enrollment
Eye Examination Report by certified Ophthalmologist
howToApply: Report to the JRD Tata Sports Complex, Jamshedpur, during open trial notification dates announced in local newspapers and sports portals.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Equipment is provided for testing during trials.

title: Hockey India Junior National Championship Selection Camp
titleHi: हॉकी इंडिया जूनियर नेशनल चैंपियनशिप चयन शिविर
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Represent the state team at the Hockey India National Championship, scouting opportunity for the Indian Junior National Team camp.
eligibility: Registered hockey players under age 19 participating in district leagues, school games, or registered club championships.
documents: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from school or club
howToApply: Contact your registered District Hockey Association secretary to nominate your name for the inter-district trials.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Turf shoes and shin guards are compulsory for camp participants.

title: UP Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Rural Sports Scheme
titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश पंडित दीनदयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण खेल योजना
organization: Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Free sports kit distribution, certificates signed by Youth Welfare department, and prize money for block and district champions.
eligibility: Youth residing in rural village panchayats of Uttar Pradesh. Open to both school-going and non-school youth within age limits.
documents: Gram Panchayat Pariwar Register copy or Birth Certificate
howToApply: Enroll with the Block Development Youth Welfare Officer (Khand Vikas Adhikari) or Regional Sports Stadium in your district headquarters.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Events organized at Block level first, followed by District finals.

title: Punjab Sports Department Day-Boarding Football Academy Wing
titleHi: पंजाब खेल विभाग डे-बोर्डिंग फुटबॉल अकादमी विंग
organization: Department of Sports, Government of Punjab
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Daily refreshment allowance, free football boots and kit, coaching under certified NIS coaches, and entry into State School Games.
eligibility: Students studying in Punjab schools. Trial comprises 50m sprint, shuttle run, juggling, passing accuracy, and match situation play.
howToApply: Attend open trials held annually at the district stadium or Mahilpur Football Academy grounds. Check official state sports portal for reporting schedule.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Bring own football studs and shin guards.

title: Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP) Rural Talent Hunt
titleHi: स्पोर्ट्स अथॉरिटी ऑफ आंध्र प्रदेश (SAAP) ग्रामीण प्रतिभा खोज
deadline: Check official website for current dates
benefits: Admission into SAAP Sports Academies, specialized cricket batting and bowling nets, physical conditioning coaches, and lodging.
eligibility: Youth resident in Andhra Pradesh showing athletic talent in cricket bowling (measured with speed radar) or batting reflex drills.
documents: Date of Birth Certificate from Municipal / Panchayat
howToApply: Register on the SAAP portal or visit the local District Sports Development Officer (DSDO) at the district stadium.
verificationNote: Verify on the official site before applying. Selections are supervised by senior certified coaches.
